text: Garlic and onions are both members of the allium family, which includes aubergines, chives, leeks, onions, and shallots, all known for their rich flavor and medicinal properties. Garlic, especially, has been cherished for its health benefits since ancient times, being utilized for its potential to prevent diseases such as heart disease, cancer, and infections. Both garlic and onions are rich in allicin, a compound that produces their distinctive flavors and also has health-promoting qualities. Onions, particularly the red, yellow, and white varieties, are often used in cooking and also possess antifungal, antibacterial, and antioxidative properties. They are appreciated for their savory, pungent flavor and are commonly used in various cuisines around the world. Garlic and onions are not only culinary staples but are also regarded as household remedies due to their health benefits.
